description.en: Shows a full tutorial image panel: slides it in from off-screen while playing a voice-over sound, shows a "next" prompt animation, waits for the player to advance it (via BtnImageNext), optionally plays a decide SE, then slides the panel back out and deletes it.
Tutorial image file name (without extension/suffix), loaded from data/tutorial/<name>_<LG>.xa.
Voice-over sound event ID to play alongside the image.
Whether to play the "decide" confirmation SE once the player advances past the image.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a tutorial image with its voice-over, as ShowTutorial2 does internally
ShowTutorialEx(_imgFileName, "str_005", true);
